lines.beaver_en: Wow, did you pack a lunch again today?
lines.learner: 네, 인스턴트만 먹으니까 몸이 안 좋았어요.
lines.en: Yes, eating only instant food made me feel bad.
lines.roman: Ne, inseuteonteuman meogeunikka momi an joasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How is it, now that you've tried packing it yourself?
lines.en: After trying it myself, it was easier than I thought.

lines.beaver_en: So many side dishes. What did you put in?
lines.en: I put in bulgogi I made last night.
I packed a lot, so please share it.
Yes, I brought strawberries for dessert.

lines.beaver: 와, 하루 세 끼 다 이렇게 먹어요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, do you eat all three meals like this?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, haru se kki da ireoke meogeoyo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 아침은 못 먹어서 두 끼만 먹어요.
lines.en: No, I skip breakfast, so I only eat two meals.
lines.roman: Aniyo, achimeun mon meogeoseo du kkiman meogeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. What about the team dinner tonight?
lines.learner: 갈 거예요. 그런데 술은 조금만 마실게요.
lines.en: I'll go. But I'll only drink a little.
lines.roman: Gal geoyeyo. Geureonde sureun jogeumman masilgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why? Can't you hold your liquor?
lines.learner: 지난번에 포도주를 마셔 보니까 금방 취했어요.
lines.en: Last time I tried wine, I got drunk quickly.
lines.roman: Jinanbeone podojureul masyeo bonikka geumbang chwihaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 오늘은 주스 마셔요. 도시락 정말 맛있어요!
lines.beaver_en: Then have juice tonight. Your lunch is really good!
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom oneureun juseu masyeoyo. Dosirak jeongmal masisseoyo!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 다음엔 도시락을 하나 더 싸 올게요.
lines.en: Thanks. Next time I'll pack one more lunch.
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Daeumen dosirageul hana deo ssa olgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? I'll look forward to it. Let's get back to work!
lines.en: Okay, let's go. Hang in there this afternoon!
